dedupe_keys.name: servizio wms carta storica delle valanghe

description: Servizio WMS Carta Storica delle Valanghe is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by antincendio.regione.abruzzo.it. The service dynamically produces the map of the Historical Charter of the Valanghe, the map contains the graphic representation of the avalanche events recorded by the station controls of the Forestry Corps Regional Command Abruzzo in the period from 1957 to 2013. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "WMS Valanghe Historical Paper Service" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Servizio di accesso a mappe, valanghe, slavine. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
